'''Lizhu''' is an NPC in {{Location|Jinzhou}}.

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events|Lizhu}}
* [[Pincer Maneuver Warriors (Quest)]]

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Indoor, at Morning)
:'''Lizhu:''' Phew... Everyone else is working, but I'm here slacking off and loving it... Haha!
:{{DIcon}} Here you are...
:'''Lizhu:''' Hang on, you're not planning to snitch to Mr. [[Mortefi]], right...?
:{{DIcon}} Are you scared?
:'''Lizhu:''' Mr. Mortefi is scarier than my own mentor.
:'''Lizhu:''' His words can be brutal... If he sees me slacking off, he'll probably say something like...
:'''Lizhu:''' "Taking a little break, I see. You must enlighten me about your vast knowledge of avoiding work."
:'''Lizhu:''' Just so you know, that's the 17th most brutal line from Mr. Mortefi, as per our rankings on the Huaxu Hive.
:{{DIcon}} That's only ranked the 17th?
:'''Lizhu:''' Oddly enough, some people don't mind his scolding... In fact, they seem to provoke him on purpose.
:'''Lizhu:''' I really can't understand what those people are thinking...
----
;(Outdoor, at Afternoon)
:'''Lizhu:''' The war in the [[Norfall Barrens]] has finally ended.
:'''Lizhu:''' That [[Retroact Rain]] was horrible, wasn't it?
:'''Lizhu:''' The Retroact Rain was already scary as an illusion... but then actual "ghosts" appeared!
:{{DIcon}} It could be caused by the [[Threnodian]]'s awakening.
:'''Lizhu:''' Yeah, we thought so too. The Threnodian seemed on the brink of awakening... and its recent activities have already had such a terrible impact.
:'''Lizhu:''' Can you believe the [[Fractsidus]] wanted to hatch such a terrifying creature...
:'''Lizhu:''' I heard Fractsidus members were part of this Threnodian revival too. Rover, any insights?
:{{DIcon}} I'm not quite sure either.
:'''Lizhu:''' Ah, too bad. I was hoping to get more information from you...
:{{DIcon}} Where did you hear all these rumors, anyway?
:'''Lizhu:''' Of course, it's all online!
----
;(Indoor, at Night)
:'''Lizhu:''' [[Crownless]]... No way, the progress on the frequency calculations is only at 7%...
:{{DIcon}} What are you doing?
:'''Lizhu:''' I'm analyzing the Crownless data. I've never seen such a complex Tacet Discord before.
:'''Lizhu:''' By the way, did you know? Miss [[Baizhi]] actually came up with the term "Crownless." What a pity.
:{{DIcon}} Why is it a pity?
:'''Lizhu:''' Don't you think the name is a bit... uninspired? Miss Baizhi is a genius at everything, except naming Tacet Discords.
:'''Lizhu:''' Everyone on the forums wants a more memorable name. They even held a virtual contest for suggestions.
:{{DIcon}} For example?
:'''Lizhu:''' My favorite is "Savage God of Torn Wings." What do you think, Rover?
:{{DIcon}} I think "Crownless" is a better name...
::'''Lizhu:''' No way... Did Miss Baizhi blackmail you??
:{{DIcon}} "Savage God of Torn Wings" is the better name.
::'''Lizhu:''' Haha, Rover, you've got great taste!
:{{DIcon}} I don't really care.
::'''Lizhu:''' In the end, Miss Baizhi, as the discoverer, has the final say.
----
{{Dialogue End}}
